channel.title: Morning Digest News
channel.description: South Korean officials free a shark trapped for a month in Busan canal

item.title: New UN initiative will aim to tackle the military uses of AI
item.description: The United Nations is launching a new initiative on the military uses of artificial intelligence, aimed at addressing some dire concerns about the threat the rapidly developing technology could pose to humanity

item.title: The Orionid meteor shower is coming. Here's how and when to watch
item.description: The Orionid meteor shower, caused by remnants from Halley’s comet, peaks this week

item.title: Justice Kagan warns Supreme Court rulings are fueling polarization and undermining democracy
item.description: Justice Elena Kagan says decisions by her conservative Supreme Court colleagues have increased political polarization and weakened democracy in the U.S. She spoke Tuesday, two weeks before the midterm elections, criticizing rulings that weakened the Voting Rights Act and campaign finance regulations

item.title: AL champion Rays were mainly built by wise trades and low-cost signings
item.description: The Tampa Bay Rays were built into American League champions through savvy trades, budget-friendly signings and an organizational strength in identifying, developing and maximizing talent

item.title: Brewers promised a ticket to any future game for $1,000. Some fans unhappy with World Series seats
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers ran a promotion over a decade ago offering fans a “Timeless Ticket” granting them admission to any game in the future if they paid $1,000

item.title: NFL defends Eagles' handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clots while union calls for an investigation
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles are not being punished for how they handled quarterback Jalen Hurts’ blood clots, according to a person with knowledge of the situation

item.title: Macron slams as ‘stupid’ claims by Trump and others blaming Muslim migrants for French riots
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has criticized foreign leaders, including U.S. President Donald Trump, saying they exploit unrest in France for political gain

item.title: A 'Treasury of Ice' goes on show, revealing relics as Swiss glaciers rapidly melt
item.description: The Glacier Garden in Lucerne is showcasing artifacts from Switzerland's glaciers in an exhibit called "Treasury of Ice."

item.title: Malaysia bans civil servants from using navigation app Waze, citing data risks over Israeli links
item.description: Malaysia has banned civil servants from using the navigation app Waze due to data security concerns linked to its Israeli origins

item.title: CNN threatens new legal action, saying it's still being denied access to Air Force One
item.description: CNN has threatened further legal action if its journalists continue to be denied access to Air Force One

item.title: Trucker protest leaves supermarket shelves and gas pumps empty in southern Italy
item.description: Supermarkets and gas stations in Naples are facing shortages due to weeklong protests by truck drivers against high gasoline costs

item.title: A New Jersey food importer files a lawsuit challenging Trump's 50% tariffs on Canadian goods
item.description: A New Jersey food importer has filed a lawsuit challenging President Donald Trump’s power to invoke a Depression-era law to levy a 50% tariff on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods

item.title: Beijing blasts US sanctions on 5 Chinese firms tied to ex-Google engineer
item.description: Beijing has expressed strong opposition to U.S. sanctions on five Chinese companies linked to a former Google engineer accused of intellectual property theft

item.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX reports a profit and he hints at a possible merger with Tesla
item.description: SpaceX reported a bigger quarterly profit than expected Tuesday as its satellite communications and artificial intelligence businesses boomed

item.title: South Korean officials free a shark trapped for a month in Busan canal
item.description: South Korean officials have freed a large gray shark trapped for over a month in a canal in Busan
